preconditions.description: The set size n is between 5 and b (inclusive), b is at most 10000, and n is divisible by 5.
The number of hints q is between 1 and 10000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= upTo <= b and 0 <= quantity <= n for upTo, quantity in hints)
preconditions.description: Each hint (upTo, quantity) has upTo between 1 and b, and quantity between 0 and n.
The required count of elements for each remainder modulo 5 is exactly n/5.

postconditions.description: Output 'fair' if there exists a set of n distinct integers in [1, b] satisfying the modulo-5 distribution and all hints; otherwise output 'unfair'.

A valid set exists if and only if all hints are mutually consistent (non-decreasing counts with valid bounds) and it is possible to select exactly n/5 numbers for each remainder class within [1, b] while respecting the cumulative counts implied by the hints.
